entities.summary: Gilberto Pereira Lopes was a Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of Ipameri from 1966 to 1975, archbishop coadjutor from 1975 to 1982, and archbishop from 1982 to 2004 of Campinas. Lopes died on 22 September 2025, at the age of 98.
